full_prompt_en: A square graphic illustration shows a strange upright tree-like form with one large circular eye dominating the left half of a stylized desert town. Its broad round crown is built from nested bands of ocher, sage, teal, and dark green, enclosing a bright yellow-orange iris and black pupil. A thick gray-green trunk descends into the lower scene, branching into thin dark limbs and short crossbars. Near the center-right, a tall pale tower rises with a pointed red roof, small dark windows, and a few simple inset shapes. Behind it, low stacked buildings and more spindly cactus-like trees stretch toward the horizon. The sky is patterned with flat layered clouds in muted green and cream, a small pale yellow sun near the upper-right side, and scattered tiny dark marks. Across the lower third, a horizontal band of blocky walls, rectangles, leaves, and circular eyes or flower centers builds a dense foreground. Small red and orange plant forms punctuate the muted teal and olive shapes. The scene is assembled from crisp flat pieces and slightly distressed color, not realistic modeling. Warm orange and mustard areas sit beside blue-green, charcoal, cream, and pale dusty yellow. Shadows are graphic and shallow; even ambient light keeps details visible across the full frame. Repeating rings around the giant eye echo smaller circles in the plants and buildings. The whole composition balances a single oversized watcher against the thin tower and a crowded horizontal base, producing a playful, eerie, ornamental landscape.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图形插画描绘一座程式化沙漠小镇，左半幅由一棵奇异、竖立、只有一只大圆眼的树形物主导。宽圆树冠由赭黄、鼠尾草绿、青绿和深绿的套叠色带构成，围着亮黄橘色虹膜和黑色瞳孔。粗灰绿色树干向下伸入下方景物，分出细深色枝条和短横杈。中央偏右，一座高窄浅色塔楼顶着红尖屋顶，开有小深窗和简单嵌入形。其后，低矮层叠的房屋和更多细瘦仙人掌状树木伸向地平线。天空布满柔绿与奶油色扁平叠云，右上附近有一枚小浅黄太阳，还散着极细小深色记号。下方三分之一，块状墙、矩形、叶片以及圆形眼睛或花心组成密集的水平前景带。小红橘植物形点在柔青绿和橄榄色块之间。场景由利落扁平碎片和略显磨旧的颜色拼成，而非写实塑形。暖橘、芥黄紧邻蓝绿、炭灰、奶油色和灰淡黄。阴影图形化且浅，均匀环境光让全画细节都可见。巨眼周围的重复圆环呼应植物和建筑里的小圆形。整体构图以一名过大的注视者平衡细窄高塔和拥挤水平基底，形成俏皮、怪异且富装饰性的景观。
style_prompt_en: Graphic illustration uses crisp cut-paper-like shapes, nested color bands, repeated circles, and a dense horizontal rhythm of small angular marks. Keep modeling shallow and shadows simple; let flat ocher, mustard, teal, sage, charcoal, cream, and dusty orange zones interlock. Slightly worn grain and speckling add tactile life to otherwise sharp-edged geometry. One oversized concentric focal form can balance a thin vertical accent and many miniature motifs. Even ambient illumination keeps the entire patterned field readable rather than isolating a single lit object. Repeat rings at different scales to tie distant sections together, and break rectilinear grids with spindly organic lines. The transferable effect is playful and mildly uncanny, organized through scale contrast, decorative repetition, and weathered color blocks.
style_prompt_zh: 图形插画使用像剪纸般利落的形状、套叠色带、重复圆环和由细小棱角记号组成的密集水平节奏。塑形保持浅薄，阴影简单；让赭黄、芥黄、青绿、鼠尾草绿、炭灰、奶油色和灰橘的平涂区域相互咬合。轻微磨旧颗粒与斑点为锐边几何增添触感。一处过大的同心焦点形体可以平衡细长竖向重点与众多微型纹样。均匀环境光让整片纹样可读，而非隔出单一受光物。不同尺度重复圆环以联结远近区域，再用细瘦有机线条打断矩形格网。可迁移的效果俏皮而略显诡异，由尺度反差、装饰性重复和磨旧色块组织。
theme_en: A giant one-eyed tree beside a narrow tower in a stylized desert
theme_zh: 程式化沙漠中一棵巨大的独眼树立在窄塔旁
name: Tim Biskup
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
